india.one_line: Sarvam AI releases an upgraded 105B model and a multilingual dictation API.

themes.title: Sarvam ships 105B model and dictation API
themes.text: Sarvam AI released an upgraded 105-billion-parameter model, Sarvam-105B-1711, and launched Sarvam Dictate, an API that transcribes speech in English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute, pairing its Saaras V4 speech model with the 105B LLM. The company also defended hosting Chinese open-weight models on its Token Factory platform, saying it runs on privately procured GPUs.

stories.headline: Sarvam defends hosting Chinese models, releases upgraded 105B model
